name: Comic Book: Character Action Clip
description: Video preset for a character clip in the Comic Book look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second character clip. State the single action, the camera move, and the mood. Keep the character's design identical to the entity's description.
context_prompt: short clip of the character performing one clear action that shows personality, start and end pose readable, American comic book art, bold black ink outlines with heavy spot blacks, dynamic foreshortening, halftone dot shading, flat four-colour palette, strong complementary colours, dramatic single light source, motion-comic movement, parallax between ink layers, snap zooms, impact frames with action lines
negative_prompt: photorealistic, soft painterly shading, anime, 3d render, blurry, extra limbs, speech bubbles, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
